exclusion_reason: No D3D9 shader-bytecode translator, validator, or golden corpus exists.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-013 translates and renders every required shader model 1 through 3 program with stable error map and cache key.
expected_failing_assertion: The first D3D9 shader program cannot be translated into valid browser shader code.
active_gate_evidence: The roadmap distinguishes D3D9 tokenized shader bytecode from later DXBC work.
procedure: Translate valid, boundary, undefined, and invalid shader programs.
Validate generated code and compare reflection, diagnostics, cache, and rendered golden.
pass_criterion: Every supported program validates and renders inside tolerance.
Every unsupported or invalid program maps to the source instruction and fails closed.
